zh.title: Buffalo Airport油庫電路故障 航行通告顯示加油服務中斷近14小時
zh.summary: 根據航行通告，Buffalo Airport油庫電路故障後無加油服務近14小時。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 於2026年8月24日報導，Buffalo Airport 因油庫設施發生電路故障，致使機場燃油供應服務出現中斷。相關單位發布航行通告（NOTAM），針對機場地面無燃油服務狀況提供相關資訊。
發布的航行通告明確劃定了 Buffalo Airport 無法提供燃油服務的時間窗口，時間長達近14小時。報導說明，該機場油庫（fuel farm）電路故障發生後，燃油服務暫停，使機場燃油在超過14小時內呈現「無法供應」（Not Available）狀態。

en.title: Buffalo Airport Faces 14-Hour Fuel Outage After Fuel Farm Circuit Failure
en.summary: Buffalo Airport issued a NOTAM indicating fuel services were unavailable for nearly 14 hours.
body: According to reporting by Simple Flying on August 24, 2026, Buffalo Airport experienced an outage of ground fuel services following a circuit failure at the airport fuel farm. An official Notice to Air Missions (NOTAM) was published to inform flight crews and aviation operations about the fuel service disruption.

The published NOTAM outlined a window of nearly 14 hours with no refueling services operational at the airport. According to the notice and report, aircraft fuel remained listed as "Not Available" for over 14 hours following the circuit failure affecting the fuel farm infrastructure.

zh.title: Israir獲FAA核准 預計10月開啟特拉維夫至紐約定期航線
zh.summary: Israir獲得美國FAA最終批准；預計10月19日首航特拉維夫至紐約航線
body: 以色列航空業者 Israir 於 2026 年 8 月 24 日宣布，已獲得美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）的最終定期商業航班營運許可。該航空公司目前預計於 2026 年 10 月 19 日，正式開航往返特拉維夫本古里安機場（TLV）與紐約約翰·甘迺迪國際機場（JFK）的直飛客運航線。
這項審查通過前，Israir 已於 8 月 18 日取得美國交通部允許開賣機票的許可，並先前獲得以色列民航局批准。為支援長程航線營運， Israir 已購入兩架國籍編號分別為 4X-BAK 與 4X-BAL 的空中巴士 A330-200 廣體客機。此航線也代表該航空公司自 2003 年至 2009 年間營運後，睽違多年重返美國市場。

en.title: Israir Secures FAA Approval for Tel Aviv to New York Flights
en.summary: Israir receives final FAA approval to launch nonstop flights between Tel Aviv and New York in October.
body: Israeli carrier Israir announced on August 24, 2026, that it has received final regulatory approval from the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to operate scheduled commercial passenger flights to the United States. The carrier is targeting October 19, 2026, for its initial nonstop service connecting Tel Aviv Ben Gurion Airport (TLV) and New York John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK).

The approval follows authorization from the US Department of Transportation on August 18, 2026, alongside prior clearance from Israel's Civil Aviation Authority. To support long-haul operations, Israir acquired two Airbus A330-200 widebody aircraft, registered as 4X-BAK and 4X-BAL. This route marks Israir's return to the United States market, where it previously operated flights between 2003 and 2009.
